universityName: The University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)

evidence.evidenceSnippet: UNSW College recommends Microsoft Copilot with Commercial Data Protection as the generative AI platform for coursework or assessment when generative AI use is allowed.

universityName: The University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)
description: UNSW's official AI chat service with enterprise data protection.
howToObtain: Sign in at Microsoft Copilot with zID@ad.unsw.edu.au, zPass, and MFA.
costToUser: Not specified; protected under UNSW's Microsoft licence.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: UNSW's official MyIT page says Copilot Chat is available to all UNSW staff and students. It is built into UNSW's Microsoft environment and protected under UNSW's Microsoft licence. Users sign in with their zID, zPass, and MFA; UNSW calls Copilot its official AI chat.

universityName: University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)
description: Enterprise generative AI platform provided via strategic partnership with OpenAI. Currently deployed to professional and academic staff, Higher Degree Research (HDR) candidates, and casual academic staff, with expansion to all students planned ahead of the 2027 academic year. Institutional access is distinct from course-specific assessment permissions; pricing and individual acquisition mechanisms remain unspecified.
howToObtain: Not specified in reviewed sources; follow the applicable UNSW institutional rollout.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
This week, access to ChatGPT Edu is being extended to Higher Degree Research candidates and casual academic staff, building on existing access for professional and academic staff.
UNSW is also working towards expanding access to AI tools across the entire student community ahead of the 2027 academic year.

universityName: University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)
description: UNSW College student guidance presents Mentor AI as an approved tool for writing, listening and speaking practice, in the ELICOS guidance section. It does not establish access conditions for other UNSW programs.
howToObtain: Provided in the UNSW College student-guidance context; specific account provisioning not stated.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: As a UNSW College student, you will receive access to  Mentor AI . This approved UNSW College AI tool will help you to practice your writing, listening and speaking skills.
